Plots and Figures

pgfplots line, bar and scatter charts, grouped plots and subfigures that match the paper's fonts, with no image export step.

What it adds

  • Snippet: Line plot (pgfplots)
  • Snippet: Grouped bar chart (pgfplots)
  • Snippet: Scatter plot with error bars
  • Snippet: Two plots side by side
  • Snippet: Two-panel figure

Install Plots and Figures

In LatexDo, open the Extensions view, find Plots and Figures and choose Install. It is free.
